title: Prague Gaming & TECH Summit — In Pictures
excerpt: A visual story of three days at the Prague Gaming & TECH Summit — keynotes, lounges, and the off-stage moments that built the most context.
introHtml:
A visual story of three days at the Prague Gaming & TECH Summit — keynotes, lounges, and the off-stage moments that built the most context for our roadmap.

This is the lighter companion to our Prague recap: the same days through a different lens.

sections.title: Around the Main Stage
sections.bodyHtml:
The main stage gave the structure: clear panels, sharp moderators, and a strong selection of operators. The headline keynotes acted more like agenda-setters than deep dives — useful as a shared baseline for the side conversations that followed.

If you only have time for one part of an event like Prague, the main stage on day two is usually it.

subsections.title: What we tracked from the audience:
subsections.bodyHtml:
• Live questions about retention and lifetime value
  • The framing of compliance topics across markets
  • How operators talked about data sharing
  • Audience reactions to honest cost discussions

sections.title: Off-Stage and in the Lounges
sections.bodyHtml:
The hospitality lounges were where most of the actual planning happened. Smaller groups, tighter conversations, and a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than any panel could deliver.

Most of the meetings we held there will eventually surface as updates on affiliate.makeberry.com.
